events.title: Holders 첼시 suffer a first hurdle defeat in the FA Cup when they lost 5–3 to 맨체스터 유나이티드 , while Conference club 스티버니지 Borough achieve a shock 2–1 away win over Division One 스윈던 타운 .
반즐리's defensive frailties show no sign of easing as they lose 6–0 to 웨스트햄 유나이티드 at Upton Park.
반즐리 boost their survival hopes with a 1–0 home win over 크리스털 팰리스, whose own recent downturn in form is threatening to cost them their Premier League status.
월솔 FC 's hopes of pulling off a giant-killing feat in the FA Cup fourth round are ended when 맨체스터 유나이티드 crush them 5–1 at Old Trafford.

스티버니지 Borough's FA Cup run continues when they hold Premier League club 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 to a 1–1 draw at Broadhall Way , though a controversial refereeing decision saw them denied a goal which clearly went over the line and would have made them the first non-league time since 서턴 유나이티드 in 1989 to beat a top division club in the FA Cup.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 sign Swedish striker Andreas Andersson from AC 밀란 .

맨체스터 유나이티드 remain top of the Premier League as January draws to a close, despite losing 1–0 at home to 레스터 시티. They now lead their nearest rivals 첼시, 블랙번 로버스 and 리버풀 by a four-point margin. 아스널 are beginning to rescue their season as they are now fifth in the league and just eight points off the top, with a game in hand. 반즐리 remain bottom and 토트넘 홋스퍼 have yet to climb clear of the bottom three, but 에버턴 have jumped clear of the drop zone at the expense of 볼턴 원더러스. 노팅엄 포리스트 and 미들즈브러 continue to lead the way in Division One. 찰턴 애슬레틱, 선덜랜드, 셰필드 유나이티드 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 complete the top six.
